One theme, two widths

Both frames load the same document, generated from the shipping theme — the phone frame is simply 390 CSS pixels wide, so the theme’s own breakpoints produce the mobile layout for real. Each device navigates independently: put desktop on Product and the phone on Checkout.

Desktop · 1280px

Phone · 390px

Scroll and click inside either frame — search, check a delivery PIN, build a box, sign out and check out as a guest. On the phone the menu opens from the ☰ button, as WordPress’s navigation block does on the live site. Generated by tools/render-device-view.py; never hand-edited.
